name: TTK Prestige Limited
about: TTK Prestige Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells kitchen and home appliances under the Prestige and Judge brands in India and internationally. The company offers pressure cookers; cookware; cooking appliances, such as gas stoves, induction/infrared cooktops, rice cookers, OTG, and air fryers; food preparation products, including mixers and wet grinders, hand blenders, hand mixers, electric choppers, and grain grinders; and breakfast and snacks products comprising toasters, kettles, juicers, coffee makers, egg boilers, and yogurt makers. It also provides chimneys/kitchen hoods; home appliances consisting of irons, water purifiers, vacuum cleaners, roti makers, and fruit and vegetable cleaners; accessories, such as bottles and flasks, knife/knife sets, veggie cutters, cooker separators, barbeque sets, gaskets, cleaning tools, ladders, dust bins, copper water dispensers, and gas lighters; and wedding gift. The company sells its products through a network of outlets under the Prestige Xclusive name; and e-commerce platform. TTK Prestige Limited was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
